name: The Inn

evidence.note: Summary: two-level venue with three bars, live music and DJs until 4 am; crowds sing and dance along with local bands.
Review summary says band shows draw a crowd that sings and dances along.
Krush lists many past shows at The Inn, Long Beach, confirming it as a regular band venue.

dancing.notes: This is a busy party bar where crowds sing and dance along with local cover bands and DJs. Expect a crowded, standing room on band nights.

description: A two-level bar and restaurant in Long Beach's West End with three bars, bar food, and live bands and DJs that run late into the night.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). 'LB' = Long Beach. Krush's Oct 3 5 pm show was not found on the band's or venue's calendar, but Krush plays The Inn often. Long Beach is a city in Nassau County.
